title: Harborline Customer Accounts: Calculating the Hosting Renewal Prefund
content:
# Calculating the hosting renewal prefund

## Customers the prefund handles

It handles a customer whose hosting billing shows exactly one initial-term charge, meaning one hosting plan ever ordered, while that plan is active with auto-renew on and its next auto-renew attempt is today or no more than 14 calendar days after today, the plan has no scheduled downgrade, the account's most recent tier review neither started a downgrade grace nor found a downgrade due, the plan's free domain, if any, is neither in its renewal grace period nor in redemption, the plan carries at most one active site security plan and at most one active certificate subscription with auto-renew on, at most one active email subscription is on its primary domain, and that email subscription, if any, is neither billed annually in monthly instalments nor scheduled to change product; a deposit for any other purpose, or by any other customer, is the amount the holder chooses, under the base deposit rule, and charges of any other holding are not counted by the prefund.

A product's next auto-renew attempt is the first of its first attempt day and its retry days under its own charter that is today or later. For the plan these are the hosting charter's first auto-renew attempt day before the term end date, then 3 and 1 calendar days before its term end date, the hosting charter's retry days. For the plan's free domain they are the domain charter's first auto-renew attempt day before its expiry date, then 14, 7 and 1 calendar days before its expiry date, the domain charter's retry days. A certificate has no retry days: its single attempt day is the SSL charter's auto-renew day before the subscription end date.

## The calculation

1. Because account credit pays an auto-renew charge only when the credit balance covers the whole charge, the prefund covers each counted charge in full.
2. The plan's renewal list price is the plan tier's regular 12-month monthly rate times 12, the regular rate of the 12-month term.
3. The plan's renewal list price is reduced by the account tier's hosting discount, the discount being the list price less the reduced price rounded half up to the cent.
4. The free-domain charge of the prefund is the auto-renew charge of the domain registered under the plan's free-domain entitlement where that domain is active or on hold with auto-renew on and its next auto-renew attempt is today or no more than 14 calendar days after today: its renewal for the TLD's auto-renew term years at the TLD's renewal price times those years reduced by the account tier's domain renewal discount and rounded half up to the cent, plus the ICANN fee per year times those years, which is never discounted; otherwise no free-domain charge is counted.
5. The certificate the prefund counts is the certificate subscription installed on the plan, active with auto-renew on, when its next auto-renew attempt is today or no more than 14 calendar days after today; its charge is the auto-renew charge the SSL/TLS Certificates published auto-renew rule sets, whichever source pays it. It renews for the years of its latest term line, its latest renewal or auto-renew line or, where none has been billed, its purchase line, at most the product's maximum subscription years, and its certificate price component is the product's price for those years: the 3-year price per year times 3 for three years, the 2-year price per year times 2 for two years and the 1-year price for one year.
6. Its certificate price component is reduced by the account tier's SSL discount; its extra names are billed without that percentage at the product's price per year for each extra name, for each name and each year renewed, each name's yearly price multiplied, on a renewal of two or three years, by the product's per-year price for that term divided by its 1-year price, and, on such a renewal, the names after the first 10 taken at 0.6 of that price up to the first 50 names and at 0.4 of it beyond them.
7. The reduced amount, the reduced certificate price component together with the extra-name amount, is rounded half up to the cent, and the certificate charge is that amount with the fixed fee added and the fixed credit taken off that apply to it, rounded half up to the cent; a certificate not so due has no certificate charge.
8. The credit the prefund must cover is the plan's renewal list price together with every other counted charge, all added together, less every discount that applies.
9. The credit balance counted is the sum of all the account's credit ledger entries.
10. The prefund deposit is the credit the prefund must cover less the credit balance; where that is zero or less no prefund is needed and none is taken, and otherwise the prefund is at least the tier's minimum deposit and is rounded half up to the cent.
11. A prefund that would exceed the tier's maximum per transaction, or that would raise the credit balance above the tier's maximum credit balance, is refused in full and no prefund is taken.

The plan's rates are those of its tier on Web Hosting Plans, the free domain's those of its TLD on Domain Registrations and the certificate's those of its product on SSL/TLS Certificates; the discounts, the minimum deposit, the maximum per transaction and the maximum credit balance are those of the account's tier.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A Harborline Reseller Silver account (hosting discount 15 percent, domain renewal discount 5 percent, minimum deposit $100.00) has one plan whose regular 12-month monthly rate is $8.45, with its next attempt 9 days from today, and a credit balance of $22.60. The plan's free domain is active with auto-renew on, its next attempt 11 days from today, on a TLD renewing 1 year at a renewal price of $13.40 with an ICANN fee of $0.30. No certificate on the plan is due within the 14 days.

- Renewal list price: $8.45 times 12, $101.40; reduced price $101.40 times 0.85, $86.19; discount $15.21.
- Free-domain charge: $13.40 times 0.95, $12.73, plus $0.30, $13.03.
- Credit to cover: $86.19 plus $13.03, $99.22. Less the balance: $76.62.
- The prefund is at least $100.00, so the prefund deposit is $100.00.

On a Harborline Personal Account with the same holdings and balance (no discounts, minimum deposit $25.00), the credit to cover is $101.40 plus $13.70, $115.10, and the prefund deposit is $92.50.

## Certificate reduced amount (hypothetical product figures)

A certificate renewing for two years, with a 1-year price of $90.00, a 2-year price per year of $72.00, an extra-name price of $5.00 per year and 12 extra names, on an account with a 15 percent SSL discount:

- Price component: $72.00 times 2, $144.00, reduced by 15 percent to $122.40.
- Name yearly price: $5.00 times $72.00 divided by $90.00, $4.00. Names counted: the first 10 in full and 2 at 0.6, 11.2 name units; extra names $4.00 times 11.2 times 2 years, $89.60.
- Reduced amount: $122.40 plus $89.60, $212.00.

A one-year renewal bills every extra name at the full yearly price: 2 extra names at $7.50 per year on a $54.00 one-year price under the same discount give $45.90 plus $15.00, $60.90.

## Window boundary

| Next attempt of the plan | In scope |
|---|---|
| today | yes |
| 14 calendar days after today | yes |
| 15 calendar days after today | no |

*Applies to: Harborline Customer Accounts*
